jobs.description_text: AI Singapore (AISG) is a national initiative driven by the Ministry of Digital Development and Information (MDDI), the Infocomm Media Development Authority (IMDA), and the National Research Foundation, Singapore (NRF). AISG brings together Singapore-based research institutions and the broader ecosystem of AI start-ups and companies to support impactful research, develop talent and power Singapore's AI efforts. For more information on AI Singapore, please visit https://www.aisingapore.org . This position will be hosted at the Nanyang Technological University (NTU) under VP (Artificial Intelligence & Digital Economy)’s office and we welcome you to join our community. As Platforms Team Lead, AI Systems Engineering, you will lead the team that builds and runs AISG's platform for developing, training, evaluating and deploying AI models, including GenAI and LLM applications. You will set the team's technical direction and standards, grow its engineers, deliver the team's AIAP training, co-lead the AIAP Sovereign AI track, and help AIAP, AIEH and partner teams get their projects into production. Key Responsibilities: Own the AI Systems Engineering roadmap, architecture and build-versus-buy decisions for MLOps, GenAI and LLM systems. Set engineering standards, paved roads and production-readiness checks for project teams. Set service levels for critical services, lead the response to major incidents, and manage operational and security risks. Oversee CI/CD, evaluation, monitoring and LLM inference and serving, optimising for reliability, cost and GPU utilisation. Drive infrastructure-as-code and automation, turning recurring requests into self-service workflows. Lead and coach the team's engineers, and lead hiring for the team together with the Head, Platforms Engineering. Co-lead the AI Apprenticeship Programme (AIAP) Sovereign AI track with other Platforms Engineering leads, from recruitment and assessment to curriculum and in-person mentoring. Own the AIAP MLOps and LLMOps modules, and support technical assessments and interviews. Work with AISG Heads and partners to align the team's work with AISG programmes, and provide budget and procurement input. Job Requirements: A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field, or equivalent professional experience. At least 8 years of relevant experience in software, platform or infrastructure engineering, including substantial hands-on experience in DevOps, DataOps or MLOps. Experience leading technical workstreams, owning a platform end to end, or mentoring other engineers. Experience running production systems, including incident response. Proficiency in Python, Go or Rust, Linux administration, and at least one major cloud platform. Hands-on experience with infrastructure-as-code, containers and Kubernetes. Solid understanding of machine learning concepts. LLM inference or GenAI experience is highly advantageous. Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills. We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU

jobs.description_text: The Division of Information Technology and Operations Management at Nanyang Business School is inviting applications for a Research Assistant (RA) position. The Research Assistant will join a series of research in healthcare settings. The role will focus on supporting the research project with data preparation, cleaning, and analysis. Key Responsibilities: Conduct on-site research coordination and data preparation in healthcare settings, including collaboration with hospitals, clinics, and institutional partners to facilitate data access and research implementation. Acquire, integrate, and manage multi-source datasets, including electronic health records, system log data, survey data, and other administrative datasets required for research projects. Perform data cleaning, preprocessing, and quality assurance, ensuring large-scale datasets are properly structured, anonymized, and suitable for statistical and machine learning analysis. Develop and implement data analysis pipelines using Python and SQL to process structured and unstructured data (e.g., text, medical images, or voice records). Apply advanced analytical techniques, including machine learning and natural language processing, to extract insights from healthcare-related datasets. Job Requirements: Bachelor’s Degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Information Systems, Biomedical Informatics, or a related quantitative discipline. A Master’s Degree will be an advantage. Relevant experience in data analytics or research support, preferably in healthcare, digital health, or large-scale data environments. Strong programming skills in Python and SQL, with demonstrated ability to process and analyze large datasets. Experience working with unstructured data, such as text, image, or audio data, including familiarity with techniques such as natural language processing, computer vision, or speech data processing. Knowledge of data preprocessing, feature engineering, and machine learning workflows, with the ability to implement analytical pipelines for empirical research. Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with experience in data cleaning, exploratory data analysis, and statistical modeling. Ability to manage and integrate multi-source datasets, including structured and unstructured data from digital systems, surveys, or administrative databases. Good written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document analytical processes and support research reporting. Strong organizational and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work both independently and collaboratively in interdisciplinary research teams and healthcare environments. We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU

jobs.description_text: The Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine (LKCMedicine) trains doctors who put patients at the centre of their exemplary care. The School, which offers both undergraduate and graduate programmes, is named after local philanthropist Tan Sri Dato Lee Kong Chian. Established in 2010 by Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, in partnership with Imperial College London, LKCMedicine aims to be a model for innovative medical education and a centre for transformative research. The School’s primary clinical partner is the National Healthcare Group, a leader in public healthcare recognised for the quality of its medical expertise, facilities and teaching. The School is transitioning to an NTU medical school ahead of the 2028 successful conclusion of the NTU-Imperial partnership to set up a Joint Medical School. In August 2024, we welcomed our first intake of the NTU MBBS programme, that has been recently enhanced to include themes like precision medicine and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare, with an expanded scope in the medical humanities. Graduates from the five-year undergraduate medical degree programme will have a strong understanding of the scientific basis of medicine, with an emphasis on technology, data science and the humanities. LKCMedicine is recruiting a Research Assistant/Associate for the Respiratory and Infectious Diseases Programme, Laboratory of Antimicrobial Resistance and Drug Discovery under Professor Pablo Bifani. The lab is working in applied phage biology with the aim of developing recombinant phages for therapeutic and/or diagnostic purposes. These phages are to be used to treat patients affected by otherwise untreatable multidrug resistant organisms or recalcitrant bacterial infections. The successful development of phages with therapeutic potential could have a direct impact on lifesaving or quality of life improvement. Key Responsibilities: Carry-out standard microbiology techniques, bacterial cultures and phage production, isolation, characterization, etc. The focus of the job will be on the genetic manipulations/engineering of selected bacteriophages. These will include knock-out, knock-in, mutagenesis etc. Responsible for the phage recombinant work in the lab Bacterial cultures Phage Target deconvolution (understanding mechanisms of action and resistance of selected phages) Design and conduct experiments including data collection and analysis Knowledge of bioinformatic tools would be helpful Summarize and present the data in lab meetings Develop new research techniques and approaches Perform maintenance of inventory and procurement of laboratory consumables Manage the grant and basic logistical requirements associated with the project Ensure safe technical practices and procedures Key Competencies and Requirements: Bachelors (Research Assistant) or Master (Research Associate) degree in Biomedical Sciences or related fields Expected to have a background working with bacteria and have a strong background and interest in molecular including recombinant work, genomic and transcriptomic. Knowledge or expertise working with bacteriophages will be an advantage Willingness and ability to undergo biosafety training and strictly adhere to Biosafety Level 2 (BSL-2) containment protocols when handling opportunistic and drug-resistant bacterial pathogens (e.g., M. abscessus). Highly adaptable at working with different organisms and techniques Collaborative spirit with internal and external collaborators We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: LKC
jobs.title: Research Assistant/Associate, Microbiology/Molecular Biology [LKCMedicine]

jobs.description_text: The Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS) is a University Research Institute at Nanyang Technological University Singapore that conducts fundamental research on earthquakes, volcanic eruptions, tsunamis, and climate change in and around Southeast Asia, towards safer and more sustainable societies. For more details, please view https://earthobservatory.sg/ The Earth Observatory of Singapore (EOS) invite applications for the position of Research Engineer (Hydrographic Survey and Geophysics), on a full-time, 2-year fixed-term contract. The Research Engineer II will join a new project awarded by the Public Utilities Board (PUB) and Coastal Protection and Flood Resilience Institute Singapore (CFI) collecting data from the Johor Strait to better protect Singapore’s coastline amidst climate change. This is an international, multi-institutional and trans-disciplinary program involving top researchers from the local and international community that aims to understand sediment budgets and source-to-sink relationships. Understanding the relationship between local climate drivers, coastal processes and sediment dynamics will allow for improved predictions of coastal change under the variety of climate scenarios in the coming decades. The work will involve planning and conducting offshore hydrographic and geophysical surveys (multibeam bathymetry), deploying and maintaining ADCPs and other oceanographic instruments, collecting and subsampling seabed sediments for laboratory analysis, and processing and interpreting the resulting data to quantify seabed change and sediment dynamics over monsoonal cycles. Active participation in research will be encouraged, and support for publication and meeting/conference presentations can be available. Key Responsibilities Plan and conduct offshore field surveys, including deployment and operation of pole-mounted multibeam echosounder systems for repeated bathymetric surveys across monsoon seasons. Process, QA/QC, analyse and interpret multibeam bathymetric data using GIS and hydrographic software to quantify seabed change and sediment gain and loss. Deploy, retrieve and maintain ADCPs and other field instruments, and process current and water-parameter data for the project’s modelling team. Assist with boxcore sampling and immediate onboard subsampling for laboratory sedimentological and geochemical analysis. Support the project’s geophysics work and maintain survey equipment, calibration logs and field data records. Prepare technical reports, peer-reviewed publications, presentations, and project deliverables. Maintain efficient data collection to ensure accuracy and completeness of data and preparation of the Data Management Plan for annual submission Engage in the dissemination of the results of the research with the support of and under the supervision of the Principal Investigator Job Requirements: Possess a MSc in Hydrography, Marine Geoscience/Geophysics, Ocean Engineering, Geomatics, or a closely related discipline. Hands-on experience in offshore field surveys, including small-vessel logistics and equipment deployment. Demonstrated experience operating multibeam echosounder systems and processing multibeam bathymetric data. Experience with Norbit and/or R2Sonic systems and with Beamworx software will be advantageous. Working knowledge of sediment (boxcore) sampling and subsampling. Experience in deploying ADCPs and processing ADCP data, and with other field instrumentation, will be advantageous. Proficiency in GIS and in Python, MATLAB, or similar tools will be advantageous. Ability to work independently and to contribute to technical reports and publications. A team player in a project setting, also with ability to work independently in a multi-cultural team environment Excellent written, verbal and interpersonal communication skills. Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills Interested applicants are invited to submit a full CV EOS seeks a diverse and inclusive workforce and is committed to equality of opportunity. We welcome applications from all and recruit on the basis of merit, regardless of age, race, gender, religion, marital status, family responsibilities, or disability. We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU

jobs.description_text: Nanyang Technological University, Singapore (NTU Singapore) is a world-class, research-intensive public university dedicated to providing a transformative education, advancing research, and nurturing global leaders. Driven by innovation, excellence, and a commitment to positive global impact, NTU fosters an inclusive and vibrant ecosystem where cutting-edge technology meets education. At the Institute for Pedagogical Innovation, Research and Excellence (InsPIRE) – Education Transformation, we are dedicated to advancing teaching and learning through educational innovation, research and evidence-informed practice. At the heart of our work is the strategic use of AI and learning analytics to deepen our understanding of how students learn, generate actionable insights into learning behaviours and outcomes, and empower educators to make informed pedagogical decisions. By harnessing emerging technologies, educational data and interdisciplinary research, we seek to develop innovative, personalised and inclusive learning experiences that enhance student engagement and success. We are looking for a Research Fellow to provide specialist expertise in AI-driven innovation for teaching and learning, contributing to the advancement of evidence-informed educational practices at NTU. The role will focus on leading and shaping strategic foundational and translational research directions, developing and evaluating innovative applications of AI and learning analytics to improve teaching effectiveness and student learning experiences. The Research Fellow will drive high-impact research initiatives, foster interdisciplinary collaborations, and translate research findings into actionable insights and scalable educational solutions. Applicants for the Research Fellow role should also provide research leadership. Key Responsibilities: Provide intellectual and research leadership in identifying, shaping and advancing strategic research directions in AI for advancing NTU’s signature pedagogy. Apply AI technologies, including generative AI, machine learning and learning analytics, to develop innovative and scalable educational solutions. Develop and implement technical solutions involving AI model integration, AI agents and data-driven applications, where appropriate. Conduct technical experimentation, testing and iterative refinement to optimise the functionality, reliability, usability and educational effectiveness of AI-enabled tools. Integrate technical development with empirical research to ensure that AI innovations are informed by pedagogical principles and supported by robust evidence. Translate research findings and technical innovations into actionable recommendations, reusable AI tools and scalable educational solutions that contribute to teaching and learning improvement. Contribute to knowledge-sharing activities, workshops and strategic initiatives that strengthen institutional capabilities in AI-enhanced teaching and learning. Job Requirements: PhD (for Research Fellow) qualification degree in artificial intelligence, computer science, learning analytics or related field. At least 2 years of relevant hands-on technical experience in AI, machine learning or generative AI application development, including experience in designing, developing, prototyping and evaluating AI-enabled tools or systems. Familiarity with emerging AI technologies, AI agents and analytics in educational settings, pedagogical principles and responsible AI practices, including data privacy, research ethics and AI governance, is highly desirable. Good written and oral communication skills. Proficiency in programming skills with hands-on experience in machine learning frameworks, LLM APIs, and AI application development. Experience with relevant AI development frameworks, software engineering practices and data visualization tools will be advantageous. Competent in analytical, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to independently conceptualise research studies, formulate research questions, and evaluate AI-enabled educational interventions. Experience in experimental design, learning analytics, human-centered design will be advantageous. Ability to work independently and collaboratively within interdisciplinary teams and deliver high-quality outcomes within project timelines. Demonstrate prior research leadership. We regret to inform that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU
jobs.title: Research Fellow (AI in Education)

jobs.description_text: The School of Physical and Mathematical Sciences at Nanyang Technological University invites applications for a Research Fellow in Quantum Machine Learning and Quantum Algorithms in the PIPC group (Physics of Information Processing and Complexity), led by Assistant Professor Thiparat Chotibut. The Research Fellow will combine large-scale numerical simulations and theoretical analysis to study quantum machine learning and optimisation in many-qubit systems, establishing how the performance and resource costs of existing and newly designed quantum algorithms scale with system size. Key Responsibilities: Develop algorithms and scalable simulations for many-qubit learning and optimisation. Establish scaling laws and resource requirements through theoretical analysis and controlled benchmarks. Connect numerical results to theory, publish findings in high-impact journals, and contribute to PIPC collaborations and student mentoring. Job Requirements: PhD in physics, applied mathematics, computer science, electronical engineering or a closely related field. Research record in quantum machine learning, quantum algorithms, or many-body physics. Experience in quantum simulation and strong scientific programming skills in Python, Julia, C++, MATLAB, or a comparable language (familiarity with agentic workflow development is a plus). Ability to connect theoretical analysis with numerical evidence and assess scalability and resource costs. Excellent communication, independent research skills, and ability to collaborate across disciplines. We regret that only shortlisted candidates will be notified. Hiring Institution: NTU

jobs.description_text: The Lee Kong Chian School of Medicine (LKCMedicine) trains doctors who put patients at the centre of their exemplary care. The School, which offers both undergraduate and graduate programmes, is named after local philanthropist Tan Sri Dato Lee Kong Chian. Established in 2010 by Nanyang Technological University, Singapore, in partnership with Imperial College London, LKCMedicine aims to be a model for innovative medical education and a centre for transformative research. The School’s primary clinical partner is the National Healthcare Group, a leader in public healthcare recognised for the quality of its medical expertise, facilities and teaching. The School is transitioning to an NTU medical school ahead of the 2028 successful conclusion of the NTU-Imperial partnership to set up a Joint Medical School. In August 2024, we welcomed our first intake of the NTU MBBS programme, that has been recently enhanced to include themes like precision medicine and Artificial Intelligence (AI) in healthcare, with an expanded scope in the medical humanities. Graduates from the five-year undergraduate medical degree programme will have a strong understanding of the scientific basis of medicine, with an emphasis on technology, data science and the humanities. The Hwei-Ee Tan lab studies the fundamental biological basis of “gut-feelings”, how bacteria in the gut signals to the host to influence physiology and behaviour. Using mice as a mammalian model, the lab investigates how diet and microbiome factors modulates host phenotypes (e.g. food reward, anxiety behaviours, etc). Besides supporting curiosity-driven basic research on the gut-brain axis, his lab is also studying the brain-gut axis, to uncover host-microbe interactions. His lab’s work is multidisciplinary, the research scope covers diverse skills from molecular biology to systems neuroscience, physiology and behaviour. With top-tier research support from National Research Foundation Singapore, Brain & Behavior Research Foundation (NARSAD), etc, his lab at NTU LKCMedicine is actively recruiting talented postdoctoral research fellows, research assistants, and interns, and also open to sponsoring motivated PhD/Masters students. A short-term or part-time research assistantship may also be arranged for motivated trainees. Key Responsibilities: Develop and conduct high quality research independently, as a candidate is expected to have relevant experience in one or more of these areas (e.g. mice/rodent handling, optogenetics and behaviours, animal surgery and dissection, calcium imaging, gnotobiotic studies and microbiome analysis, etc). Lead, assist or learn in a dynamic range of projects and lab duties, including but not limited to molecular biology and histology procedures, microscopy, rodent behavioural assays, neuroscience optogenetic and chemogenetic techniques, functional recording and calcium imaging, mice surgery, data analysis and presentation, lab maintenance and office, academic and administrative tasks Mentor and collaborate with group members and other research teams Demonstrate him/herself exceptionally self-motivated, a team player Any other responsibilities as advised by the PI based on the evolving needs in the lab The applicant should at least: Hold a Diploma or Bachelor degree in Biology or relevant disciplines Have a keen interest in the lab’s research theme on the microbiome gut brain neuroscience Be proficient in relevant techniques described above Be highly motivated and conscientious Demonstrate her/his competencies and qualifications satisfactorily Work independently, and also have the ability to work effectively in a team Have good organisational, verbal and interpersonal skills Hiring Institution: LKC

jobs.description_text:
OKX will be prioritising applicants who have a current right to work in Singapore, and do not require OKX's sponsorship of a visa.

Who We Are

At OKX, we believe that the future will be reshaped by crypto, and ultimately contribute to every individual's freedom. OKX is a leading crypto exchange, and the developer of OKX Wallet, giving millions access to crypto trading and decentralized crypto applications (dApps). OKX is also a trusted brand by hundreds of large institutions seeking access to crypto markets. We are safe and reliable, backed by our Proof of Reserves. Across our multiple offices globally, we are united by our core principles: We Before Me, Do the Right Thing, and Get Things Done. These shared values drive our culture, shape our processes, and foster a friendly, rewarding, and diverse environment for every OK-er. OKX is part of OKG, a group that brings the value of Blockchain to users around the world, through our leading products OKX, OKX Wallet, OKLink and more.

About the Opportunity

We are seeking a Principal Engineer with a deep expertise in autonomous AI agent architecture and deployment, to spearhead the design, development, and optimization of intelligent agent systems on our global crypto exchange platform. This is a senior role requiring a hands-on AI science background combined with strategic oversight, technical direction, and cross-functional collaboration.
You will work at the cutting edge of AI and crypto, designing AI agents that can autonomously reason, act, and evolve in complex, real-time environments such as trading, security, compliance, and customer interaction.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Lead the design, development, and lifecycle management of autonomous AI agents tailored to crypto exchange operations (e.g., customer assistant, trading bots, risk detection agents, fraud prevention agents, etc.).
  • Architect multi-agent systems (MAS) and frameworks to support goal-directed, reasoning, planning, and reinforcement-learning-based agents.
  • Collaborate with product, engineering, business, and operation teams to define agent roles and measurable KPIs.
  • Drive experimentation, simulations, and continuous learning pipelines for agent performance optimization.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on developments in AGI, LLM-integrated agents, and cognitive architectures; apply relevant innovations to production systems.
  • Mentor and lead a team of AI scientists and engineers; help define the AI roadmap and research strategy.
  • Ensure system scalability, security, and regulatory compliance of AI-powered solutions in the crypto exchange domain.

What We Look For In You

  • PhD or Master's in Computer Science, AI, Machine Learning, Robotics or related field with at least 10 years of industry experience.

  • Proven experience building and deploying autonomous AI agents in live environments. Ideal candidates will have:
    • Designed multi-agent frameworks or agent ecosystems (e.g., AutoGPT, OpenAgents, LangGraph, LangFuse, Dify, Coze, etc.).
    • Experience with goal-oriented agents, context engineering, memory management, tool use, and RL-based decision making.
    • Developed agents for real-time decision-making, such as trading, gaming, customer support, or operations.
    • Track record of delivering end-to-end AI systems in fast-paced, high-scale environments (preferably finance, crypto, or high-frequency domains).

Nice to Haves

  • Experience in top-tier AI labs or Tech industry leaders
  • Experience in high-frequency trading, fintech, Web3, or crypto platforms is a strong advantage
  • Startups or research-intensive environments preferred; must be comfortable operating with ambiguity and speed

Perks & Benefits

  • Competitive total compensation package
  • L&D programs and Education subsidy for employees' growth and development
  • Various team building programs and company events
  • Wellness and meal allowances
  • Comprehensive healthcare schemes for employees and dependants
  • More that we love to tell you along the process!
